overview: The number 666 is described in Revelation 13:18 as the number of the beast, symbolizing a man whose name carries this number. This beast is associated with blasphemy and authority over all who dwell on the earth, compelling them to receive a mark on their hand or forehead to buy or sell (Revelation 13:1, 13:16-17). Those who worship the beast are contrasted with those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life, emphasizing the spiritual battle between allegiance to Christ and submission to the beast's dominion (Revelation 13:8).
